0022600220.text: The Spurs, 9-2 and first in the Southwest, visit the 1-8 Bulls on a nine-game winning streak, with a 5-0 road record and a 9-1 mark over their last ten. Chicago is 14th in the East and 4th in the Central, 5.5 games back, and has lost seven straight. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), while Devin Vassell is day-to-day with a groin injury and a game-time decision. Chicago is without Tobe Awaka (out, back), and Caleb Wilson (hip soreness), Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation), and Zach Collins (illness) are all day-to-day game-time decisions. The Spurs have won their two meetings in 2025-26, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30, 2026, and this is the first matchup of 2026-27.
